featured_title: Moving to Estero, FL: The 2026 Complete School Enrollment Guide for Families
featured_excerpt: Your home address does not assign your child to the closest public school in Estero or anywhere in Lee County — the district uses proximity zones and a Choice Application with a lottery. Twenty minutes south in Collier County, assignment works the opposite way, by attendance boundary tied to your address.
